about: Max's hard practice set (Brief 2, Part 3, Nov 4, 2026): 40 calls that real callers make and the polite set does not: everything at once, out of order, corrections, garbled speech-to-text, confused or hostile callers, price pressure, two problems, a caller who leaves, Spanish, regulated offices, Always Open's own line, tester tricks. Every call has a must (what Max has to do) and a never (what he must not); the blind judge reads both and so does the hard-error scanner's report. Every business and person here is made up.
